entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex, agent ID 302. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand I bought. It's not working.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a fault. The GPS is completely off. It's basically garbage.

I'm sorry to hear you're experiencing trouble with the GPS. That can definitely be frustrating. I have a few troubleshooting steps that often resolve tracking inaccuracies. Do you have a moment to try them with me?
No. I really don't have time for that. I just want to send it back and get my refund.
I understand you'd prefer a direct return. Looking at your account, I see you received the VeloBand Pulse 13 days ago. Is that correct?
I guess. What does that matter? It's broken.

The delivery date is important for our return policy. For the VeloBand Pulse specifically, we have a strict 10-day return window for a full refund. This is because the device activation links the hardware to your personal account and for hygiene protocols.
So you're not going to help me? You sold me a defective product and now you just want money from me for nothing. This is ridiculous.

I want to help resolve the issue. Because you're outside the 10-day return period, our process for a defect claim is to first verify the fault through troubleshooting. Without that, I'm not authorized to process a refund. My only path forward would be to transfer you to our technical support team who can confirm the defect and initiate a warranty replacement if needed.
Fine. Whatever. So I'm stuck with this piece of garbage.
I wouldn't say you're stuck. A warranty replacement for a confirmed defect is a valid option. Would you like me to transfer you to technical support?
No. I'm done. This was a complete waste of my time.
I am sorry we couldn't come to a different resolution today. If you reconsider troubleshooting, our support lines are open 24/7. Is there anything else I can do for you?
Nope. You've been a massive help. Goodbye.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
